column1: # Words CC-CEDICT gives full tones that Standard Mandarin (mainland) reads with
# a neutral syllable. tools/build_data.py and tools/build_db.py put the neutral
# tone into the matching CC-CEDICT line as they read it, so it is drawn above
# the page (where the character gets pinyin) and shown in the popup's word line.
#   simplified word <TAB> numbered pinyin, one syllable per character (5 = neutral) <TAB> note
# The traditional form follows from CC-CEDICT. Only the tones may differ from
# the CC-CEDICT line (the syllables must be the same), and a syllable after the
# first must be 5. Single characters keep their own reading (嚏 stays tì).
